entries.issue: For Zone A the printed Tc and TL differ by one hundredth from the intersections implied by the printed Am, An, Fa and Fv.
entries.resolution: Transcribe the printed limits. The curve is drawn from the printed values, so it carries the same one-hundredth step the study published.

entries.issue: The sheet prints no I, but the national code the study complements defines one.
entries.resolution: Multiply by I under consideration (a), expose it as its own cited trace step, and record the decision in the uncertainty ledger.

entries.issue: The 2002 study is a municipal technical study. Its own consideration (a) anchors it to Ley 400 de 1997, Decreto 33 de 1998 and Decreto 34 de 1999 — the NSR-98 corpus, superseded by NSR-10 — and no municipal act adopting or extending it was located, including by a title search over 2523 published decrees.
entries.resolution: Not resolved, and not silently dropped either. The mode computes because the coefficients are attested end to end, and every result carries a currency warning citing the study's own NSR-98 anchor. This mirrors Medellín, which ships as a computable mode while its own locked sources state the adoption decree has not been issued. Demonstrating adoption, or demonstrating its absence, remains open for independent review.

entries.issue: The 2014 harmonization and the 2015 update propose a point-wise Fa/Fv surface instead of three zones.
entries.resolution: Neither publishes a reproducible table; this study stays on the 2002 zones and says so in the mode description.
